# Fire Risk Scotland

> Fire Risk Scotland (fireriskscotland.com) is a specialist fire risk assessment company covering all of Scotland from Glasgow. Assessments are carried out in person by Raj Chall BSc, lead fire risk assessor, listed on the Institution of Fire Engineers (IFE) fire risk assessor register with 15 years in fire safety. Reports are written to the Fire (Scotland) Act 2005 and the Fire Safety (Scotland) Regulations 2006. Fixed fees from £225 + VAT; written report within 48 hours of the site visit. Fire Risk Scotland is a sister company of Scottish Energy Services (https://www.scottishenergyservices.co.uk/).

Key facts:
- Business: Fire Risk Scotland, 272 Bath Street, Glasgow G2 4JR, Scotland
- Phone: 0141 255 1360 (+44 141 255 1360). Email: info@fireriskscotland.com
- Lead assessor: Raj Chall BSc, Institution of Fire Engineers fire risk assessor register, 15 years in the fire safety industry
- Area served: all of Scotland, including Glasgow, Edinburgh, Aberdeen, Dundee, Inverness, Stirling, Perth, the Highlands and islands
- Premises assessed: HMOs, short-term lets and holiday lets, offices, shops, industrial units, warehouses, pubs and restaurants, hotels, guest houses, hostels, student accommodation, care homes, churches and halls, and common areas of tenements and blocks of flats
- Price: fixed fee from £225 + VAT for smaller premises; larger and complex premises quoted individually; travel included
- Turnaround: written report within 48 hours of the site visit; urgent issues raised on the day
- Standards: PAS 79-1:2020 (non-housing), BS 9792:2025 (HMOs and flats), Scottish Government Practical Fire Safety Guidance
- Sister company: Scottish Energy Services (EPCs, SAP and SBEM calculations, Section 63, TM59, legionella risk assessments)

## Services
- [Fire Risk Assessment Scotland: What's Included & How It Works](https://fireriskscotland.com/fire-risk-assessment/): What a fire risk assessment in Scotland covers, how the site visit works, what is in the report, and how risk is rated. Written to the Fire (Scotland) Act 2005 by an IFE-registered assessor. From £225 + VAT.
- [HMO Fire Risk Assessment Scotland](https://fireriskscotland.com/hmo-fire-risk-assessment/): HMO fire risk assessments in Scotland for licence applications and renewals. What the Fire (Scotland) Act 2005 and HMO licensing require, what councils look for, common findings, and fixed fees from £225 + VAT.
- [Short-Term Let Fire Risk Assessment Scotland](https://fireriskscotland.com/short-term-let-fire-risk-assessment/): Fire risk assessments for short-term let licences in Scotland: holiday lets, B&Bs, guest houses and serviced apartments. What the mandatory fire safety conditions mean for hosts. From £225 + VAT.
- [Commercial & Workplace Fire Risk Assessment Scotland](https://fireriskscotland.com/commercial-fire-risk-assessment/): Fire risk assessments for offices, shops, factories, warehouses, pubs, restaurants and other workplaces in Scotland. Employer duties under the Fire (Scotland) Act 2005, the SFRS automatic alarm policy, and fixed fees from £225 + VAT.
- [Hotel, Guest House & Care Home Fire Risk Assessment Scotland](https://fireriskscotland.com/hotel-and-care-home-fire-risk-assessment/): Fire risk assessments for hotels, guest houses, hostels, student accommodation and care homes in Scotland. Sleeping risk, night-time evacuation, person-centred planning and Scottish Government guidance.
- [Blocks of Flats & Tenement Common Area Fire Risk Assessment Scotland](https://fireriskscotland.com/blocks-of-flats-fire-risk-assessment/): Fire risk assessments of common closes, stairs and shared areas in Scottish tenements, purpose-built blocks and high-rise flats, carried out to BS 9792:2025 for factors, housing associations and landlords.

## Guides
- [Fire Safety Law in Scotland: A Duty Holder's Guide (2026)](https://fireriskscotland.com/fire-safety-law-scotland/): A plain-English guide to fire safety law in Scotland: the Fire (Scotland) Act 2005, Fire Safety (Scotland) Regulations 2006, duty holders, relevant premises, recording and review, enforcement, penalties, and how Scotland differs from England.
- [How to Choose a Competent Fire Risk Assessor in Scotland](https://fireriskscotland.com/choosing-a-fire-risk-assessor/): How to check a fire risk assessor is competent in Scotland: the registers and certification schemes SFRS lists, BS 8674:2025, questions to ask, and warning signs of a poor assessment.
- [How Much Does a Fire Risk Assessment Cost in Scotland? From £225 + VAT](https://fireriskscotland.com/fire-risk-assessment-cost/): Fire risk assessment prices in Scotland. Fixed fees from £225 + VAT for smaller premises, what affects the price, what is included, and how to get an accurate fixed quote.
- [Fire Risk Assessment FAQs Scotland: Law, Costs, Reviews](https://fireriskscotland.com/faq/): Answers to common questions about fire risk assessments in Scotland: the law, who needs one, what is checked, how often to review, how much it costs and how to book.
